name: Survey tile in Gemini
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Gemini, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 5 visits over 73 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 35 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.1 days starting 2026-03-30, at wavelengths from 0.83 to 4.40 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
